heading: Frequently Asked Questions
text2: Quick answers to the questions we hear most about this service.

items.question: Do you build in Swift or Objective-C?
items.answer: New apps are built in Swift. We also maintain and modernize existing Objective-C apps.

items.question: Will you handle App Store submission?
items.answer: Yes. We prepare metadata and screenshots, submit the app and handle review feedback.

items.question: Can you update my existing iOS app?
items.answer: Yes. We can review the code, fix issues, add features and bring the app up to the latest iOS version.

items.question: How long does iphone app development take?
items.answer: A focused app usually takes 8 to 12 weeks, while feature-rich apps with custom backends take 4 to 8 months.

items.question: Do you offer support after launch?
items.answer: Yes. We provide maintenance, updates, monitoring and new feature development after launch.
